flow_depth.name: Order to cash and customer settlement
flow_depth.path: Quotation -> Sales Order -> Delivery Note -> Sales Invoice -> Payment/Allocation -> Return/Credit -> Reconciliation
known_depth_questions: Re-run the committed ERPNext oracle differential against exact current main; stale gap labels do not count.
Reconcile current stock valuation/serial-batch behavior against the pinned oracle after later Forge stock work.
Prove partial/multiple delivery, invoice, payment, cancel/amend/backdate and race behavior end to end.
flow_depth.rationale: O2C is materially implemented and has a pinned 115-fixture ERPNext oracle plus later transaction closure, but exact-current remap proves both stale old gap labels and still-open business-policy/correction differences. Deep parity is not yet supportable.
confirmed_findings: Pinned oracle capture is valid at 115/115 fixtures, but its older Forge-side gap prose is stale for several capabilities now present on exact current main.
Credit-limit/hold remains an explicit Sales/Finance dependency in the transaction-closure record.
Fully-paid return/refund/customer-credit policy remains an explicit Finance dependency.
Historical downstream COGS/expense restatement after wider backdated valuation effects remains deferred in transaction convergence.
Current Forge blocks expired-batch delivery while pinned ERPNext v16.20.0 oracle observes expiry as advisory; this is a real semantic divergence requiring an explicit policy disposition.

flow_depth.name: Procure to pay and supplier settlement
flow_depth.path: Material Request -> RFQ -> Supplier Quotation -> Purchase Order -> Purchase Receipt -> Purchase Invoice -> Payment -> Reconciliation
flow_depth.rationale: Forge has a P2P transaction-closure lineage, but R8 has not yet compared the whole flow behaviorally against the pinned ERPNext runtime.

flow_depth.name: AR/AP allocation, advance and reconciliation
flow_depth.path: Invoice -> Payment Entry -> allocation/unallocation -> advance -> reconciliation -> reversal
flow_depth.rationale: Meaningful current settlement semantics are proven in Forge, including FX difference posting and canonical Payment Ledger usage, but full ERPNext behavioral depth remains unproven.
confirmed_findings: Current Payment Entry authority includes historical-rate base allocation and explicit exchange-difference GL posting.
AR/AP settlement and reversal authorities exist with integrated transaction-closure evidence.
ERPNext-exact settlement ordering, customer-credit/refund policy and branch/dimension depth are not fully closed by R8.

flow_depth.name: General ledger, periods and financial close
flow_depth.path: Voucher posting -> GL -> trial balance -> financial statements -> period close -> reopen/correction
flow_depth.rationale: R8 must compare accounting invariants and report reconciliation, not just presence of GL rows.

flow_depth.name: Cash, bank transactions and reconciliation
flow_depth.path: Bank statement evidence -> match/allocation -> reconciliation -> reversal -> cash/bank reporting
flow_depth.rationale: The existing feature matrix explicitly describes bank reconciliation as foundation-level at v0.9; exact current main must be re-audited.

flow_depth.name: Pricing, taxes, rounding and multi-currency
flow_depth.path: Price resolution -> pricing rule -> tax calculation -> rounding -> base/transaction currency -> FX settlement
flow_depth.rationale: The old advanced-tax/FX missing list understates exact current Forge, but current code still exposes narrower combinations than ERPNext and the 115-fixture differential has not been replayed against the later implementation.
confirmed_findings: Current totals engine implements included tax for additive On Net Total rows, Actual charges, On Item Quantity, On Previous Row Total, fixed/percentage document discounts and explicit rounding adjustment.
Current Payment Entry code posts realized exchange differences; the older oracle prose saying FX gain/loss is missing is stale.
Included tax combined with document discount is explicitly rejected and included tax is restricted to additive On Net Total, so full ERPNext tax-composition depth is not yet proven.

flow_depth.name: Inventory quantity, valuation, backdate and repost
flow_depth.path: Receipt/Issue/Transfer/Reconciliation -> Stock Ledger -> valuation -> backdate -> repost -> GL reconciliation
flow_depth.rationale: Stock valuation is now substantial, but ERPNext depth is broader and current downstream repost/landed-cost behavior is not closed.
confirmed_findings: Current Forge has server-ledger FIFO and Moving Average valuation plus bounded repost/adjustment logic, so the older oracle prose saying no valuation engine exists is stale.
Pinned ERPNext oracle includes LIFO behavior; current Forge ValuationMethod is FIFO or Moving Average only.
Historical downstream COGS/expense restatement and authoritative landed-cost application/reversal remain explicit deferred boundaries.

flow_depth.name: Serial, batch, expiry and genealogy
flow_depth.path: Identity creation -> receipt -> reservation/pick -> consumption/delivery -> return/cancel -> traceability
flow_depth.rationale: Serial/batch behavior is materially implemented but includes at least one confirmed ERPNext semantic divergence and broader unclosed policy depth.
confirmed_findings: Current Forge has a Serial and Batch Bundle model, single-use usage tracking, per-batch valuation and serial quantity/uniqueness guards; the older 'no bundle model' gap is stale.
Forge rejects an outgoing expired batch; pinned ERPNext v16.20.0 oracle records expired-batch delivery as allowed/advisory.
Expiry/warranty/recall and complete ERPNext item-master policy remain broader than current Forge evidence.

flow_depth.name: Reservation, ATP, putaway, pick, pack and replenishment
flow_depth.path: Demand -> reservation/ATP -> putaway -> picking -> packing -> transfer/delivery -> release/correction
flow_depth.rationale: Forge has WMS orchestration, but R8 must distinguish ERPNext parity from Forge-specific superset behavior.

flow_depth.name: BOM, routing, MRP and production planning
flow_depth.path: BOM/version -> routing/capacity -> demand -> Production Plan/MRP -> Work Order
flow_depth.rationale: Current manufacturing closure is not itself ERPNext source-exact proof.

flow_depth.name: Shop-floor execution, WIP, scrap and manufacturing cost
flow_depth.path: Work Order -> material transfer/issue -> Job Card -> FG/scrap -> actual cost/variance -> reversal
flow_depth.rationale: Forge records a read-only cost reconciliation model; R8 must compare ERPNext posting and costing depth explicitly.

flow_depth.name: Subcontracting procurement and supplied-material accounting
flow_depth.path: Subcontracting Order -> material supply -> subcontracted receipt -> consumption/valuation -> payable
flow_depth.rationale: Subcontracting artifacts exist in the ERPNext denominator; current Forge depth must be proven rather than assumed.

flow_depth.name: Asset acquisition, depreciation, movement, repair and disposal
flow_depth.path: Acquire/capitalize -> depreciate -> move -> repair -> value adjust -> sell/scrap -> GL
flow_depth.rationale: Forge reports an asset lifecycle beta; R8 still needs pinned ERPNext behavior comparison.

flow_depth.name: Projects, tasks, timesheets and profitability
flow_depth.path: Project/Task -> time/cost -> billing linkage -> profitability -> correction
flow_depth.rationale: Presence of project reports is not a full ERPNext business-depth claim.

flow_depth.name: Quality inspection and quality-management loop
flow_depth.rationale: The feature matrix itself distinguishes transactional inspection from foundation-only quality features.

flow_depth.name: Issue, SLA, warranty and maintenance service
flow_depth.path: Issue/Warranty Claim -> SLA -> maintenance schedule/visit -> parts/billing evidence -> closure
flow_depth.rationale: Forge has a service closure candidate, while portal/email boundaries remain known weak areas.

flow_depth.name: POS, product bundle, subscription and repeat commerce
flow_depth.path: POS opening -> sale/payment/stock -> closing plus subscription/auto-repeat/product bundle
flow_depth.rationale: Forge POS is beta while subscription/website breadth is not claimed.

flow_depth.name: Regional accounting, tax, e-invoice and statutory localization
flow_depth.path: Country profile -> chart/tax/withholding -> statutory document -> filing/e-invoice/report
known_depth_questions: Vietnam statutory authority vs generic ERPNext regional modules
flow_depth.rationale: Forge has Vietnam-specific work, but ERPNext regional artifacts and local legal requirements must be separated and compared explicitly.
